original_input: University Wi-Fi is not working and my exam starts in one hour!

triage.summary: Student reports university Wi‑Fi is down and an exam is starting soon

routing.reason: The issue is a campus Wi‑Fi outage affecting an imminent exam; IT Service Desk handles network problems and can provide immediate support, while the Study Office should be notified for potential exam impact.

solution.diagnosis: Likely a campus Wi‑Fi outage affecting the student’s device, which is critical because an exam starts soon

steps.action: Forget the eduroam network on your device and reconnect using your full university username and password
Check if other devices or classmates in the same room have the same Wi‑Fi problem to determine if it is a device issue or a network outage
If Wi‑Fi remains unavailable, switch to a temporary workaround such as a wired connection, a nearby computer lab, or a mobile hotspot
Document the problem with time, screenshots, error messages and any witnesses (e.g., classmates) as evidence for the exam impact
Immediately inform your exam instructor about the Wi‑Fi issue before the exam starts, providing the documented evidence
Report the outage to the IT Service Desk via the ticket form or help‑desk counter, including building, room, start time, device type and error details
If the exam is disrupted, follow the Study Office procedure to submit a formal request for an academic exception, attaching the documented evidence

time_critical_actions: Reconnect to eduroam after forgetting the network
Switch to a wired connection, computer lab or mobile hotspot as a temporary workaround
Inform the exam instructor immediately before the exam starts
assumptions: The student has a device capable of forgetting and reconnecting to Wi‑Fi
A wired network or hotspot is available nearby
The exam instructor can be contacted before the exam begins
lessons_applied: For urgent or time-sensitive cases, fill time_critical_actions with what must happen first. (auditor rejected this 6x before)
contact_department must be exactly one of the routed department names. (auditor rejected this 3x before)
When an exam is mentioned, tell the student to inform the examiner/instructor before it starts. (auditor rejected this 1x before)
Earlier auditor remark in this category: The plan omits the KB-EXAM-01 procedure to document the problem (time, screenshots, error messages, witnesses) as evidence.
